messages:
sara: heads-up — Horizon Labs is seeing p99 embed latency spike over the last 30m, SLA risk flagged by CS :warning:

sara: stack traces look like KV cache misses + routing to shared pool under high load. CS wants an ETA for a short-term workaround and an owner for the code change.

aj: on it. assigning eng-platform to confirm fallback behavior. can someone grab logs for pool-3 and tail latency? @leo? :eyes:

leo: pulling logs now, tail looks like sustained spikes when seq_len > 1024. sample log: `2026-03-18T14:02:12Z ERROR model-serve request_id=abc123 p99=1.8s KV_MISS=true`

jamal: quick workaround options: 1) route Horizon -> dedicated pool (cheap, fast) 2) enable prefix KV cache TTL=30m 3) reduce batch_max to 4 for customer traffic. prefer 1+2 short term.

maria: I can open the routing PR for a soft redirect to dedicated-pool-horizon and add metric + canary. will need a CR. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821

aj: thanks. jamal can you own the canary config? maria will own the PR. leo will validate metrics and logs. I'll coordinate CS comms.

jamal: will own canary, timeline: start rollout in 30m, monitor 15m, full shift in 90m if stable.

leo: will add dashboard tiles and an alert threshold for p99 > 1s. pinging oncall-bot to create temp incident channel.

oncall-bot: Created channel #incident-horizon-1799993333 and added stakeholders.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 — changes: routing rule + opt-in header `x-horizon-fallback`. added e2e test, details in PR description. tagging @jamal for rollout plan.

jamal: saw the PR, small nit in routing code, pushing patch now. ETA 10m.

maria: patch pushed, request for CR: @aj @leo — small change in router: `if (customer=="horizon" && env==prod) route = dedicatedPool;` Please review.

aj: reviewing now, will approve after one more test.

leo: approving once dashboard reflects metric. added temporary alert `horizon.p99 > 1s`.

aj: approved and merged. triggers CI and deploy pipeline.

devops-bot: deployment started: deployment-id=deploy-8902 env=prod target=router service. logs: `deploy-8902: started`

maria: rolling canary to 5% for Horizon traffic. monitoring.

leo: p99 trending down on canary to 0.45s after 7m. great.

jamal: starting full shift to dedicated pool now. expected finish + validation in 45m.

sara: thanks team. CS updated: told them owners (maria/jamal/leo) and timeline ~1h for full mitigation.

aj: follow-ups: 1) postmortem for why KV misses spiked 2) longer-term: autoscale dedicated pool earlier 3) add regression test to prevent seq_len fallback. filing tickets.

maria: created ticket INF-7123 (postmortem) and INF-7124 (autoscale tuning).

leo: I'll attach graphs and the canary run in the incident channel.

sara: closing loop — if anything regresses ping this thread. great job :thumbsup:
